title: Released view returns 0 rows although data exists (privileged-only association target)
symptom: SELECT from a released view (e.g. I_MRPController) returns no rows for the user even without WHERE, on a client where business data is readable.
rootCause: The view is only reachable through @AccessControl.privilegedAssociations of another view (I_ManufacturingOrder lists _MRPController), so direct access is filtered to nothing.

solutions.label: Use the released value-help view
solutions.body: e.g. I_MRPControllerVH: rows for every plant, applies the viewer's own authorization.

solutions.label: WITH PRIVILEGED ACCESS
solutions.body: Not chosen: drops the authority checks of the whole SELECT.

prevention: An empty result from a released view is a finding to explain, not a fact about the data.
